body:
The complete unmatched-source campaign is preparing evidence-backed proposals for genuinely new ingredient owners. At reviewed dependency #1158 head `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`, native receipts can record these new owners and canonical rows, but the release assembler intentionally has no positive admission route for several new-row shapes. They correctly default to `WITHHOLD`; this issue is a capability prerequisite, not a claim that refusal is a defect.

Verified boundaries:

- A new local stock identity with nonempty `other` cannot use the bare-local exception, even if every qualified token has been reviewed.
- An entirely new CAS identity / broader ontology parent / local registry triplet cannot use `FormFollowups`: its parent and CAS claims require real predecessor positions and archived prior owner bytes. Only the added registry handle may lack a prior basis.
- A new exact CHEBI or MICRO identity row has no positive added-row route. A general review bundle alone is not registered release authority.

The prior #1070 decision concerns retained CAS-primary forms and explicitly preserves these legacy safeguards. #850 requires approval of exact archived owner bytes. Neither authorizes new-owner support by analogy.

If positive release of these campaign rows is pursued, implement a separate, explicitly registered, closed admission document binding the native `new_record` receipt, every added row, exact integrated owner bytes, individual scientific claims, primary captures, complete token review and applicable prior negatives. Preserve distinct stock/supplied-form identities, source-qualified alias scope, CAS triplet claim independence, supported B1 siblings and withdrawal after any later owner/row change. Mapping admission must not approve roles, components or whole records.

Keep all existing gates unchanged. Test actual native assembly and export with positives for each supported shape, plus missing/extra claims, fabricated history, wrong form/parent/namespace, unsafe aliases, unresolved negatives, stale or changed-and-restored inputs, missing B1 and duplicate authority. Obtain independent review before using any new path.

Do not remove legitimate aliases to fit the bare-row exception, simulate retained history, change grades to evade refusal, omit required rows or hand-author a supported export ledger. Until a valid reviewed path exists, preserve these rows as withheld and report that limitation.

Source-bound analysis: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/new-owner-admission-v1/README.md`, SHA256 `97aa629e32b05000dd5140fb02413d2d135794262651a4a5c0009b17a8036184`; manifest SHA256 `4d09ec7aae735df9bdba4243a2d98d65916d819665787b24a6cd6ab734d642af`. Seventeen source files were checked against the exact dependency commit; a separate code read agrees. This was static characterization, not a test run or scientific approval. No native code, record, mapping, workflow or gate has changed for this issue.
title: Provide explicit content-bound admission for genuinely new reviewed SSSOM owners
